summary: Iteration 2 frontend e2e: verified MainHub, Shop (buy/equip + localStorage persistence across reload), 10-character roster with locked-char purchase+equip, BiomeSelect (5 biomes, lock state correct - only dungeon clickable, hell/sakura/ice/tech disabled with LOCKED text), Playing screen (512x384 canvas, HUD shows 'DUNGEON · ROOM 1 / 6'), mini-map renders top-right (visible in screenshot), Twin-Beam weapon fires while 'o' held without any console errors or pageerrors. Persistence verified: after buying hat-straw and page.reload(), localStorage contains ownedItems:['hat-straw'] and wardrobe-item-hat-straw is visible in Character screen. Robot Good-Job double-lock could not be deeply verified in automation (same issue as iteration 1 - reaching robot is movement-heavy), but quiz/exit infrastructure is intact from previous iteration.

integration_issues.issue: Could not directly verify in automation that a correctly answered robot stops re-triggering. Quiz dialog did not open during one robot-approach attempt (player drift). The completed-flag code path exists in ProbabilityDungeon.jsx + QuizDialog.jsx (data-testid='quiz-good-job') and looks correct, but live confirmation is recommended.

issues: Top of mini-map text 'DUNGEON 1/6' appears partially clipped against the canvas top edge in the rendered overlay (cosmetic, see screenshot - the white label sits flush with frame top).

action_items: Manually verify robot 'Good job' deactivation by entering dungeon with twin-beam, killing nearby skeletons, then approaching robot, answering correctly, and re-approaching - the quiz should NOT reopen and robot sprite should appear grey/deactivated.
Consider shifting mini-map down a couple of pixels so its 'DUNGEON 1/6' label is not flush with the canvas top frame (cosmetic).
Optional: keep iteration_1 suggestion to extend player iframes after handleQuizExit to let QA re-approach robots without dying to nearby mobs.
critical_code_review_comments: store.js KEY 'probability-dungeon-save-v2' - good versioning. load() correctly spreads DEFAULT to handle older saves missing new fields (ownedCharacters, ownedWeapons, biomesUnlocked).
buyItem / buyCharacter both deduct coins atomically and persist - correct. They return {ok:false, reason:'broke'|'owned'} cleanly.
BiomeSelect disabled prop is bound to !unlocked AND opacity-50 + cursor-not-allowed - matches the spec for locked biomes.
Shop.jsx renders 4 TabsContent panels but each filters CLOTHES by slot internally, so the outer itemsForTab variable on line 44 is unused dead code - safe to remove.
ProbabilityDungeon.jsx is still ~700+ lines (carry-over from iteration 1). Consider splitting room-build / render / loop modules.
drawTwinBeam call site reads weapon from save state; no try/catch around beam render - if WEAPON_BY_ID lookup ever returns undefined we could crash. Defensive `if (!w) return` would harden it.
items.js rollChestReward: chestTier 1 and 2 both use the same pool (filters w.tier<=2). Minor design inconsistency - chestTier 2 was probably intended to include tier 3 weapons.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (Hub/Shop/Character/Biome/Playing/TwinBeam/Persistence all PASS; Robot double-lock not directly verified but code path correct)

seed_data_creation: Seeded localStorage via page.evaluate with {coins:9999, ownedWeapons:['sword','twin-beam'], biomesUnlocked:['dungeon']} for individual tests; reset between tests by reload + re-seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 11 declared iteration-2 features pass except the live robot Good-Job verification, which is gated by the same skeleton-lethality issue noted in iteration_1.json's RCA. To verify, recommend seeding a save where coins are high, weapon is twin-beam, and use page.evaluate to mutate the game's stateRef.current.player.iframesUntil = Infinity before approaching the robot. Mini-map is canvas-drawn in the top-right area inside the game canvas - visible in screenshots, no DOM testid available.
rca of the issue: Robot double-lock not directly verifiable in automation - same RCA as iteration 1: the player is bumped only 14px after handleQuizExit and adjacent mobs continue to chase during the quiz, so reaching the robot a second time before dying is hard. Code path (ProbabilityDungeon.jsx isRoomCleared() + robot.isCompleted flag + QuizDialog completed prop) is implemented and looks correct.
